note: Brands that must not appear anywhere on the page. The official catalogue already answers this through config/brand-policy.json - a brand with no entry there is never collected - but the retail run publishes whatever the shops list, so it had no lever at all: removing Oakley Factory Team from the brand policy left 29CM free to keep listing it. An entry here is matched on the canonical brand and on the spellings given, so a licensee's own trading name is caught too.
